notes.below_minimum: Short <12, medium <35, long <65 words; proxy for premature stopping.
notes.eos_probability: Raw model softmax on the sampled continuation at reached positions; conditional on reaching that position.
notes.format_anomaly: Empty, label-only, unexpected section label, or anchored instruction phrase.
notes.topic_contact: Any hand-specified concept stem in first 50 words on 42/50 prompts.
notes.unfinished_tail: Output ending in alphanumeric character; can also be a valid lyric ending.
notes.manual_editor_meta: Internal targeted read found editor or assistant language missed by the automatic format-anomaly proxy; this count is separate and not exhaustive.
notes.heldout_loss: Ordinary unweighted completion loss on the same 22 L3 held-out passages; lower loss is not a creative-quality score.
